Fig. 2. Overview of online dual-path retrieval and iterative retrieval-reasoning. Given a complex medical question, the model first decomposes it into a set of sub-questions. For each sub-question, evidence is retrieved in parallel via graph retrieval, which explicitly models dependencies among entities, and Dense Retrieval, which captures fine-grained semantic information from unstructured text. The retrieved results from both paths are then fused using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) [3] to generate sub-answers, which are incorporated into the context to guide subsequent reasoning iterations.
